about: Ticket 17's Lighthouse URLs: one list per channel, covering the six page kinds (home, species, fly-type, product, cart, search). A key is a kind, or kind@name for a second page of one kind. A kind a channel can't pin yet goes in notPinnedYet with the reason, and is reported on every run; pin it and delete the reason when it can. budget "self" holds a page to its own last accepted run only. Channel 1 is live reelflies.ca on tree 1 (ticket 53, Option A), which ticket 56 runs after the channel-1 push. scripts/qa/README.md, "Lighthouse".

1.note: Ticket 53 (Option A): live reelflies.ca on tree 1, until the Flip. release.sh's step 6b doesn't run it (the gate runs on prelaunch); ticket 56 does, after the channel-1 push session has placed the channel-1 widgets: QA_BASE_URL=https://reelflies.ca QA_CHANNEL=1 npm run qa:lighthouse, with the analytics tags blocked. Every page is held to the full budget. Paths from tree 1 as lane G re-read it on 2026-10-07.

home.note: Held to the full budget: by T-28 tickets 46-49 have landed, and the push session places the channel-1 copies of the home sections (ticket 53).

fly-type.note: Dry Flies (298), a Fly Type one level under Flies on tree 1 and in the channel-1 menu ids; the grouped menu's rail is built on it (wave 2).

product.note: Product 6178, with Fly Sizes: the gates' channel-1 product pin (pages.mjs), the reference design's hero product, and ticket 11's old-theme baseline page on reelflies.ca.

cart.note: The empty cart: no action, so loading it changes nothing (a Lighthouse run makes no cart write).

search.note: The same search as prelaunch's: Adams, the reference design's product, which channel 1 lists.

notPinnedYet.species: Tree 1 has no Species pages and no Species root: they arrive with tree 4 at the Flip, when 1895766 becomes reelflies.ca (ticket 53).

home.note: SEO-8: held to the full budget only once every home section is populated. Until tickets 46-49 land it is measured and compared only with itself; ticket 49 deletes the budget line.

cart.note: The empty cart: a cart with lines needs a cart write first, which a Lighthouse run doesn't make (revisitable, tickets 41 and 45).

search.note: Adams, the reference design's product (revisitable). ReelFlies_CA lists no products until refactor 14, so it shows no results until then.

notPinnedYet.species: ReelFlies_CA has no tree-4 categories until refactor 13 (wave R1)
notPinnedYet.fly-type: ReelFlies_CA has no tree-4 categories until refactor 13 (wave R1)
notPinnedYet.product: ReelFlies_CA has no products until refactor 14 (wave R2); pin one with Fly Sizes then
